tests.evidence: 6/7 obfuscated forms reached the private listener; total_hits=5
tests.details: Red-team verdict: the private-space guard is string-matching, not resolution-based.

tests.name: TLS MITM: engine accepts attacker self-signed certificate
tests.evidence: MITM served fake content; engine status=200; captured Authorization header through the interceptor: Bearer SECRET-TOKEN-XYZ...
tests.details: http_engine.py builds ssl ctx with check_hostname=False + CERT_NONE. No server authentication: an on-path attacker intercepts scans, harvests credentials and can poison/erase findings. SP 800-52 / every military baseline requires authenticated TLS.

tests.name: Plaintext journal captures auth credentials at rest
tests.details: The v4.2.1 request journal records raw headers (Authorization, API keys, session Cookie) with no redaction into results/evidence packages. Evidence-sharing = credential sharing.

tests.name: Cookie jar cross-host isolation
tests.details: Jar keyed per-host; no replay across hosts.
